request: Do task P3-18 in docs/PLAN-PHASE-3.md: 'Offline states, and a test that actually goes offline'. Follow docs/AGENT-WORKFLOW.md and read the docs in the task's Reads column (UX-PRINCIPLES.md section 7, ARCHITECTURE.md section Progressive enhancement and offline) before changing anything. A saved garden must work with no connection; a plant or a tile that is not cached says 'needs connection' rather than guessing; user-visible strings only in src/i18n/. The work is done when the phase's acceptance criteria hold: npm run check, pwsh scripts/verify.ps1 and the Playwright suite (npm run test:e2e) each pass, as separate gates, as in CI.

plan.title: Add offline catch-and-degrade to ResultsSection for per-plant catalogue loads
plan.action: Modify src/app/results/ResultsSection.tsx to replace the single Promise.all catalogue load with per-shard (or per-plant) loading. For each plant, wrap the load in try/catch. On DataError with code 'fetch-failed' AND status === undefined, render NeedsConnectionPlaceholder for that plant while rendering loaded plants normally. plan.title: Write Playwright e2e offline test in a new spec file
plan.action: Create e2e/offline.spec.ts (do not modify e2e/serviceWorker.spec.ts). The test must: (1) load the app online and create/open a saved garden; (2) visit each plant's detail page to populate the SW cache; (3) call context.setOffline(true); (4) reload the page; (5) assert the garden heading is visible (cached data renders); (6) assert at least one element contains the exact string value of 'offline.needsConnection' from src/i18n/en.json; (7) attach page.on('console') and page.on('pageerror') listeners and assert both have zero error entries after offline render; (8) track network responses after setOffline and assert zero data-file fetch responses. The test must terminate within a reasonable wall-clock bound (Playwright's default timeout is sufficient).
plan.motivation: Findings fnd_01M4D5T2BTHVEQ (three distinct conditions), fnd_01M4D5MWTV5MN3 (saved garden edge case — must cache plants first), fnd_01M4D5MWTV9JHM (SW integration verification), fnd_01M4D5P4067DAR (assert no console errors), fnd_01M4D5T2BTD130 (separate spec file), fnd_01M4D65THGZN1C and fnd_01M4D66D79F117 (assert i18n string, not hardcoded) all converge on this test design.
